items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Lorraine was there. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, and his sister was up...

ctx.x: So they said, "Well, get him out of the theatre." So they went to talk to him. They said, "Where he's at?" "Resting." Mister Wright said, "You know he can't rest in there." Then he said ...(?)..., "Resting? He could have killed Cab." And he was furious. And they went around, the Cotton Club boys -- they all was against Dizzy. "That's a shame. Look, man, we're all just trying to make a living. Send him up to Sing-Sing..." Dizzy's family was there.

Yeah, and his sister was up... It was sad. His sister lived up in there somewhere. There was his sister and his wife, and they had... They said, "Well, get your things." Well, Dizzy was in the dressing room with us, or the next room, and he got his belongings and everything. And they said, "Well, patch it up." He said, "Well, they could have patched it up if he just wouldn't have cut him." Because you can't have a killer on the stage. [LAUGHS]
